messages:
Priya Shah: quick flag — PR gating for evals is flaking on artifact uploads during the quantized smoke tests. seen this on 2 PRs in a row.
Alex Kim: repro logs? what specifically is failing, upload timeout or checksum mismatch?
Priya Shah: upload timeouts from gha-runner: 
```
2025-06-14T03:12:21Z ERROR upload failed: PutObject timeout after 30s
stdout: curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30001 milliseconds
```
Li Wei: runner OOMs + network blips probably. the quant smoke increases mem while writing shards. runner logs show swap thrash.
Marcos Ortega: are these the new q4_16bit builds? they raise peak memory. maybe the runner pool size too small.
Priya Shah: yes q4_16bit. gist of failing workflow: 
```yaml
name: eval-pr-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gha-ml]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: python -m evals.runner --config smoke.yaml --shards 4
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: eval-artifacts
          path: output/*.tar.gz
```
Jen (infra): we recently tightened runner autoscaling and reduced ephemeral pool to cut costs. looks like gha-runner-scaler is killing idle hosts aggressively.
eva-m: for PR gating we need reliability >95% otherwise it blocks devs. can we fallback to Buildkite for q4 runs?
Alex Kim: fallback makes sense. propose: small change — PR gating uses lightweight smoke (seq len 128, shards 1) on GHA; heavy quant smoke (seq 1024, shards 4) runs on nightly BK. keep artifact upload on S3 common path.
Marcos Ortega: agree. also add retry logic around upload step: 3 retries with backoff. quick patch: 
```
- name: upload with retries
  run: |
    for i in 1 2 3; do
      gh run upload --path output/*.tar.gz && break || sleep $((i*10))
    done
```
Li Wei: ops note — we should also pin runner labels for high-memory jobs: `runs-on: [self-hosted, gha-ml-highmem]` and ensure those instances have 64GB.
Priya Shah: can someone open a small PR to change the workflow and create a Buildkite job for the heavy smoke? I can own the PR gating YAML.
Jen (infra): I'll provision a small highmem pool and add label. ETA 3 hours.
gha-bot: scheduled nightly evals started for branch main at 2025-06-14T04:00:00Z :gear: (job id: 87432)
Alex Kim: another request — metric definition change: currently our flaky-detector marks a run failed if any artifact missing. for quant smoke we should tolerate missing metrics for up to 10% of shards and surface as warning in dashboard rather than failing gate.
eva-m: +1 on tolerating partial upload for PRs, but keep strict for nightly. dashboards need an explicit warning bucket.
Marcos Ortega: I'll add a flag `--tolerate-partial-shards` to evals-runner and a `report.partial_shards` metric. then dashboard rule: if partial_shards_rate > 0.1 for PRs -> warn, for nightly -> alert.
Priya Shah: perfect. i'll queue the PR for the gating flow + update docs in `docs/evals/ci.md`. tagging @Jen once infra is ready.
Alex Kim: should we also increase the GHA artifact upload timeout to 5 minutes? actions/upload-artifact has a 3min default AFAIK.
Jen (infra): we can set `timeout-minutes: 10` at job level for now. I'll monitor cost impact.
Li Wei: logging suggestion — add `aws s3 cp --debug` to upload step when `CI_DEBUG=true` so we can capture headers and retry reasons.
Priya Shah: noted. i'll add the debug flag gated by env. thanks all. i'll post the PR link once created. :rocket:
gha-bot: PR 4523 queued for eval-pr-smoke workflow (check runs: 3).
Priya Shah: closing loop — infra provisioned, workflow updated, fallback to Buildkite for heavy smoke, upload retries in place, partial shard tolerance flag merged. Will watch next 24h and report back if flake persists. :eyes:
